scripts.build:storybook: bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web build-storybook && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native build-storybook
scripts.typecheck: bun run plugins:contracts && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/web typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p examples/plugins/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/plugins/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tembra/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bun run typegen && bun run lint:code
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run test:mobile && bun run test:web
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.format:shared:check: node node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json packages/config packages/ui
scripts.check:ui: bun run format:shared:check && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run lint:shared
scripts.check:mobile: bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run test:mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 bun run --cwd apps/mobile check:dependencies
scripts.typegen: bun run --filter @swarmie/web generate:routes && bun run --filter @swarmie/web cf-typegen
scripts.plugins:contracts: python3 scripts/tembra/tooling.py prepare-sdk && bun scripts/tembra/build.ts contracts
scripts.plugins:build: python3 scripts/tembra/tooling.py prepare-sdk && bun scripts/tembra/build.ts plugins
